paragraphs: I'm a Data & Business Analyst who lives at the intersection of the business question and the data that answers it. Across 3+ years in healthcare, multi-client consulting, and museum operations, I've consolidated scattered source systems into single sources of truth and built the reporting that Finance, Operations, and clinical teams depend on.

What I care about is trust and clarity — catching data-quality issues before they reach a stakeholder's dashboard, automating the manual reporting that quietly drains analyst time, and translating analysis into plain-language recommendations rather than just charts. Most recently that's meant AI-augmented workflows with the Claude API that turn multi-hour weekly processes into scheduled pipelines.
From revenue-cycle KPIs in healthcare to campaign performance for consulting clients, my goal is always the decision on the other side of the data — not the pipeline behind it.
